Built for developers, it integrates seamlessly with shell scripts, CI/CD, and automation workflows, making document processing fast, scriptable, and agent-ready. | Pulse AI

articles.summary: A chart stores most of its meaning in the height of a bar or the slope of a line rather than in any character on the page. Pulse Agentic Chart Reconstruction recovers the values, scales, series, and visual encodings inside it. | Pulse AI
articles.title: Pulse Releases Agentic Chart Reconstruction
